answer: Moving-cut pass quota: each epoch the Violet beacon fixes a cut so at most 6 % of settled rows pass, instead of a fixed median of 2. Rows rank by median, then by the share of 3s from graders outside the author's funding tree. With 1000 settled rows, 60 pass; a 40-row ring fills 40 slots only by winning outside votes, which the tree filter blocks. Failure mode: a tight quota starves honest rows, so the cut drops one step when under 3 % pass for two epochs. The Knoll audit publishes cut and ranks. Cheapest bypass: many Tundra tier wallets under 20 epochs old, unless ties count per tree.
